about: Written by tools/build_kits.py; never edit by hand. The design-system kits this plugin ships, in this skill's folder: each kit's version (the plugin version in which its files last changed) and content checksum (sha256 over its sorted 'path<TAB>sha256' lines). ftk-start's ds_install.py reads it to report the bundled version and to offer an update of an older installed design system. from_forms: the folders Site Blocks reads from the Forms kit beside it.
